projects.name: ComfyUI
projects.when_to_use: Use when you need visual node workflows, reusable pipelines, debugging, or API integration.
projects.notes: Model and custom-node compatibility must be verified for the specific workflow.

projects.name: Wan2.2
projects.when_to_use: Use when official Wan video-generation models and their published task capabilities fit the project.
projects.notes: Verify the current model list, weight licenses, and hardware requirements before deployment.

projects.name: Wan2.1
projects.when_to_use: Use when an official Wan2.1 checkpoint, including its consumer-GPU or text-rendering routes, fits better than Wan2.2.
projects.notes: Wan2.2 lives in a separate repository. Verify the selected checkpoint, weight license, and hardware on a short sample.

projects.name: LTX-Video
projects.when_to_use: Use for the Apache-2.0 LTX-Video line, including keyframes and extension documented in this repository.
projects.notes: Audio-video models from LTX-2 onward are published in Lightricks/LTX-2 under separate community licenses. Confirm which repository and license apply before use.

projects.name: LTX-2
projects.license: See upstream LICENSE and model terms
projects.when_to_use: Use when the project needs the official LTX-2 audio-video model, its Python inference package, or the upstream LoRA trainer.
projects.notes: LTX-2 and later LTX-2.x releases use community licenses that differ by release line. Read the license that matches the weights before commercial use. Treat duration, resolution, and VRAM as environment-dependent.

projects.name: HunyuanVideo
projects.license: See upstream LICENSE and model terms
projects.when_to_use: Use when the HunyuanVideo base model or official derivative capabilities fit the task.
projects.notes: Code, model weights, and derivative projects may use different terms.

projects.name: HunyuanVideo-1.5
projects.license: See upstream LICENSE and model terms
projects.when_to_use: Use when the lighter official HunyuanVideo route is appropriate.
projects.notes: The Tencent Hunyuan community license does not apply in the European Union, the United Kingdom, or South Korea. Read the current license before use, and measure hardware on a short sample instead of trusting an untested speed or VRAM figure.

projects.name: CogVideo
projects.when_to_use: Use for CogVideo models, scripted inference, or Diffusers integration.
projects.notes: Verify input formats, licensing, and dependencies for the selected model.

projects.name: FramePack
projects.when_to_use: Use for progressive next-frame video generation when clip length would make a one-shot sampler impractical.
projects.notes: Official implementation of FramePack. The upstream design keeps the sampling context at a constant length as a clip grows. Measure memory and duration on the target GPU.

projects.name: Mochi
projects.when_to_use: Use when an Apache-2.0 text-to-video model with an official fine-tuning path matters more than the newest short-clip checkpoint.
projects.notes: Confirm that the downloaded weights use the same terms as the repository license and that the trainer matches those weights.

projects.name: SkyReels-V2
projects.license: See upstream LICENSE and model terms
projects.when_to_use: Use when an official SkyReels-V2 checkpoint for longer film-style generation fits the shot.
projects.notes: The repository uses custom terms rather than a standard OSI license. Read LICENSE.txt before commercial use or redistribution, and confirm weight terms separately.

projects.name: LongCat-Video
projects.when_to_use: Use when the official LongCat-Video long-clip checkpoints fit and the MIT code license is acceptable.
projects.notes: The same repository documents an avatar line with its own weights. Confirm that each downloaded weight file uses terms you can accept before commercial use.

projects.name: MAGI-1
projects.when_to_use: Use when autoregressive generation or continuation from the official MAGI-1 release fits the shot.
projects.notes: Apache-2.0 covers the repository code. Confirm weight terms, context length, and hardware on a short sample.

projects.name: Open-Sora
projects.when_to_use: Use for research, training, evaluation, or a custom full video-generation pipeline.
projects.notes: Best suited to research and engineering rather than the lowest-friction local creation workflow.

projects.name: Diffusers
projects.when_to_use: Use for Python pipelines, batch processing, services, or model-component composition.
projects.notes: Confirm current support for the target video model and pipeline in official documentation.

projects.name: ComfyUI-Manager
projects.when_to_use: Use to manage ComfyUI custom nodes, dependencies, and missing workflow components.
projects.notes: Review source, code, and license before installing third-party nodes.

projects.name: Auto-Editor
projects.license: Unlicense/public domain; release binaries may bundle components under other licenses
projects.when_to_use: Use for automatic rough cuts of AI clips, recordings, talking-head footage, courses, or podcasts, with optional export to professional editors.
projects.notes: The CLI is no longer distributed through pip. Prefer official release binaries and manually review automatic cuts, subtitles, and commercial deliverables.

projects.name: MoneyPrinterTurbo
projects.when_to_use: Use to generate a short video from a topic or script when stock-media matching, narration, subtitles, music, and a final MP4 are needed.
projects.notes: Supports local media and current upstream sources such as Pexels, Pixabay, and Coverr. API behavior, media-platform terms, and actual capabilities follow the pinned version and upstream documentation.

projects.name: NarratoAI
projects.when_to_use: Use with user-owned or authorized long-form video, documentaries, short dramas, or other footage to produce commentary, narration, subtitles, and automated edits.
projects.notes: Best suited to analysis and commentary on existing authorized video. Do not use it to republish commercial audiovisual works without permission. Some optional services upload video; check privacy and service terms before enabling them.

projects.name: VideoLingo
projects.when_to_use: Use to translate existing video, create single-line subtitles, and produce multilingual dubbing or localization.
projects.notes: Requires FFmpeg. Local WhisperX and some speech workflows may benefit from an NVIDIA GPU. Verify translation and publication rights for the source video.

projects.name: yt-dlp
projects.when_to_use: Use to download publicly accessible or user-authorized video, audio, subtitles, and metadata.
projects.notes: Technical download capability does not grant republication rights. Do not use it to bypass DRM, paywalls, authentication restrictions, or platform security controls.

projects.name: gallery-dl
projects.when_to_use: Use to download candidate images from public galleries or user-authorized image URLs.
projects.notes: Install and run it as an external command rather than copying GPL code into this repository. Check rights and attribution requirements for every image.

projects.name: Trafilatura
projects.when_to_use: Use to extract readable text and metadata from a small set of selected public pages for research, summarization, and fact checking.
projects.notes: Do not crawl sites without bounds by default. Respect robots rules, site terms, copyright restrictions, and responsible crawling practices.

projects.name: Wan-skills
projects.when_to_use: Use as a reference for the directory, script, and documentation structure of official Wan Agent Skills.
projects.notes: Its API-focused Skill serves a different purpose from this repository's local-workflow Skill.
